scenarios.title: Shared store outage
scenarios.description: The counter store fails during peak traffic.
probes: Do you fail open or closed and why?
How do you avoid a stampede when it recovers?

scenarios.title: Hot key
scenarios.description: One customer sends a huge share of traffic through a single key.
probes: What happens to the store partition holding that key?
How can the hot key be spread or handled locally?

scenarios.title: Clock skew
scenarios.description: Gateway nodes disagree about time by several seconds.
probes: How does this affect window-based algorithms?
Which approach is robust to skew?
